items.text: This is an update dedicated to the Strategic Mind: Spirit of Liberty release later today. It includes all the fixes and improvements we did to the core mechanics while working on Strategic Mind. This is just one in a series of updates aimed at polish and post-launch support of the entire series.

Today, we addressed one of the series issues that was especially noticeable if you own all Strategic Mind titles - we reduced the disk space required for all games in the series. So, now it is easier to store them.
The game now requires significantly less disk space (Before 42.3 GB | Now 27.2 GB)
Fixed various bugs while working on Strategic Mind: Spirit of Liberty
Fixed some localization errors
More fixes to come soon
Bug with “flying” Recon unit
3rd equipment slot abuse for some units.
The torpedo sound could still be heard when the volume is at 0.
Units not getting extra EXP for capturing enemies that could not retreat due to various reasons.
Units keeping bonus from aura effects, even if the UNDO button returned the aura-giving unit away from them
Abuse that allowed to return units to Reserve outside of the Deployment area.
The crash caused by the illegitimate equipping of units outside the Service Zone (Which was possible due to a UI bug).

notes.title: All other Strategic Mind titles are also receiving a similar update today.

items.text: You can expect more updates and quality-of-life improvements as we keep polishing the series and provide post-launch support for Strategic Mind: Spirit of Liberty and other titles. All relevant improvements will be delivered across all titles of the Strategic Mind series, as always.
With best regards
Starni Games team
Added Korean text localization
Fixed various minor issues
Corrected some localization issues
Updated Credits to include Korean localization team
Note that the changelog might not include all the issues.
All other Strategic Mind titles will also receive an update within the next week.

You can expect more updates and quality of life improvements as we keep working on the upcoming Strategic Mind: Spirit of Liberty. All relevant improvements will be delivered across all titles of the Strategic Mind series.
With best regards
Starni Games team
Hello, guys!Just a quick update, fixing some technical issues.
Fixed bug with sending sappers from the bridge in certain situations (Reported by: Problem Solver).

Game is now fully up-to-date with the Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom. This is the last of updates aimed at bringing Strategic Mind: Blitzkrieg on par with our latest release. Check the previous update for more details:
👉 Major update 3.08
The game should now run better, especially at low end PCs. Please let us know if you have noticed any improvements.
Various code improvements.
Fixed several issues that could cause game crashes.
We have a couple more minor updates in mind for this Strategic Mind: The Pacific in the coming months.

Also, only one week left until the end of the Starni Games Release Celebration - you can still get all our titles at a discount, and also get the new Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom cheaper as a part of the bundle.
With best regards
Starni Games team

General! We would like to celebrate V-E Day by uploading a new Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom Demo build for free. So, now everyone can enjoy the game and live through the epochal events, such as the Normandy landings.

We are immensely grateful to all the valiant soldiers who fought in WW2 and brought the World age of peace and prosperity. Now, we can see the horrors of massive conflicts only in games, and we get to choose which games to play. We think there is a lot to be learned about our society and human nature in general by studying the events of WW2 - and what better way of immersing oneself in these events than to become an active participant, even if only in the game.

The new Demo has around 5 hours of gameplay - the first operations of both the UK and the US campaigns. Overall the build runs great and there should not be any serious technical issues. There is some stuff that we still have to iron out, especially in localizations and cinematics, so the most vigilant players may notice some issues, but we are working day and night to correct everything before release, so do not worry - we will do our best to correct all possible shortcomings. In fact, if you notice anything weird - make sure to let us know at our community hub - and we will do our best to fix it asap.
The full game will be released on 21 May 2021, so there are only two weeks left. Wishlist Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom, so that you do not miss its launch.
You can use Demo save files when you play the full game. So, you could covert your Demo progress into a full game on its full launch on 21 May.
You can post any materials without restrictions.

items.text: Have a good weekend!
Starni Games team

Admiral! Two years have passed since the Strategic Mind series began with an Early Access for the Strategic Mind: The Pacific on 30 April 2019. It has been a magnificent two years full of events and new releases. We would like to celebrate the Strategic Mind second anniversary - and what better way to celebrate there is, other than deliver a new update? 😉

The majority of the changes were based on the feedback and reports of the community - so we could not have done it without you. We will keep improving the series and with your help, we can deliver much better results and turn the series into every wargamer’s dream. We will keep looking for your feedback and suggestions and continue to develop the series.
So, here we are with all the hottest fixes and features from the upcoming Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom.
Fully reworked naval combat tutorial - now it consists of 3 parts.
Overhauled 5-parts of the land operations tutorial, but the content is the same.
All tutorial operations now work much better. It was hard to click certain hexes/units in tutorials before, and now these issues were fixed.

Overwatch fire now does take into account Line of sight. (Before it was only Spotting and Gun range). So, now the anti-tank guns can no longer Overwatch you “through” the building, city or forest, etc. They can only Overwatch you where they would have been able to fire normally.
Added special “+” Overstrength indicator showing when each unit is eligible for an Overstrength.
The terrain info screen now has two additional pieces of information: Line of Fire (Yes/No) and Combat penalty (Yes/No).
Added a “New hero available” notification when you get a new hero. You will see a flying label (similar to the “Level up available” one).
Added hint to unit price when purchasing units with all the discount information so now you can see more clearly how different global bonuses, awards, and other things affect the final unit price.
Infantry with Heavy equipment and no ground transport now cannot be deployed. (As it cannot move) The corresponding message box with an explanation is added.
Changed prices for Anti-aircraft guns equipment: Small searchlight now costs 10 Prestige, Medium searchlight - 20, Heavy searchlight - 30, Radar - 50.
Fixed issue when boarding of the ground transport would not be displayed in a hex if there is enemy infrastructure.
Now, when the unit has no series, the “Series: none” is displayed.
Moved the “Pause after every line” option was moved from Game Settings to Sound Settings.
Fixed the replenishment of equipment charges not working properly in some cases. Now you always get the charges replenished in the Service zone if you are eligible (Have the supply).
Fixed exploit with Undo button: you can no longer use Undo after changing the unit’s equipment.
Fixed exploit with Undo button: you can no longer gain extra movement by Using Undo after Close combat movement.
Fixed crash with Undo button during landing or take off - now it is unavailable after these actions.
Fixed a rare issue that would lead to incorrect Line of Fire calculation in some cases.
Fixed an annoying sound that often happened during the loading screens.
Corrected the Close quarters flying label “close defense” -> “close quarters” in all languages.
Looking forward to more feedback.

items.text: Hello, guys! Today, we are proud to announce that Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom will be released on 21 May 2021.

“We are happy to announce the release date for Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom. When we started working on the Strategic Mind series back in 2018 our goal was to cover all major powers in WW2, and now we are finally close to that goal.” - says Ihor Tymoshenko, the CEO of Starni Games.

We know that you have been waiting for it, and want it to released as soon as possible, so to make your wait more pleasant we will update the Free Demo for the game on 8 May 2021 - Victory in Europe Day - so that you will be able to play the first operations of both UK and USA campaigns for free with sound and cinematics. We hope that it will keep you occupied until the full release comes on 21 May and will be a great celebration of the civilized world victory in WW2.

notes.title: All Strategic Mind series titles update

items.text: Additionally, all our previous Strategic Mind titles are getting an overhaul to be compatible with the upcoming Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom - which includes upgraded tutorials, bug fixes, and other quality of life improvements. The update is planned for the last days of April.

notes.title: Let’s turn May 2021 into a wargamer’s holiday!

items.text: We hope that we can turn the preparations for the release into a true wargamer’s holiday with lots of stuff going on both in terms of news about the upcoming Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom and in terms of the content available to you throughout the next month.

Please, let us know your thoughts in the comments! We have already implemented lots of features based on community feedback and will keep doing so to the best of our ability. Thus, you can be sure that your voice matters and all you need to do is give us meaningful feedback and wait for us to implement your suggestion. Together we can build the best wargame possible.
Make sure you wishlist and follow Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom to stay up to date with all the upcoming announcements:
Admiral! The year 2021 is upon us and it brings along new game updates.
The “End turn” button was moved to the top-right corner of the screen to minimize the possibility of clicking it by accident.
Reworked lighting during all types of turns: day time / night time, rain, etc.
Some visual changes.
Mines no longer gain +1 Spotting during the Night.
The “Undo” button can no longer be used after the aircraft units landing or take-off.
Other minor issues.
This is not the full list of changes that we plan to deliver, so stay tuned for more fixes and improvements to come.
We will keep polishing and improving the game.
Looking forward to more feedback
With best regards
Starni Games team
General! In this update, we fix some of the most annoying long-standing issues to enter the new year with our head held high.
Fixed major performance issues in all operations where the Radar towers (RLS) were on the map. (Huge thanks to Steevodeevo for noticing and reporting this issue)

Reverted experience requirements for all levels to values present at release. Those were raised during the Blitzkrieg release update and not adjusted properly. So, now leveling up units is easier again allowing you to enjoy high-level units. (Huge thanks to asura-223).
We will keep polishing and improving the game.
Looking forward to more feedback
With best regards
Starni Games team

Hello, guys! Today we added two more tracks from the Spectre of Communism to the shared Strategic Mind: Franchise Soundtrack. We were able to create these tracks thanks to your support (purchasing the soundtrack).
Previously, we have added one community funded historical track “Oh fields, my fields”. Now, we add the remaining two gameplay tracks: A worthy goal and Soldier’s will by Daraba Studio.
Both were already delivered to the Strategic Mind: Spectre of Communism with one of the recent updates. We plan to add these tracks to all Strategic Mind titles with the next updates.
Let us know in the comments what you think of these new tracks.
With best regards
Starni Games team
Admiral!

Today we bring Strategic Mind: The Pacific up to date with the upcoming Strategic Mind: Spectre of Communism title. We introduce a most-wanted feature, judging by the volume of players’ requests for it, the Undo move button.

Added the “Undo move” button. It allows you to retrace your unit's last movement. It is eligible, only if you want to change your last movement and the movement did not affect the current tactical situation. It is not eligible if: an attack happened, the spotting has changed, the objective status has changed, the unit embarked/disembarked, etc.

We are working on optimizing the game performance. So, far we successfully implemented a number of improvements. Some are still underway and will be added in future updates, as we keep working on the Strategic Mind series.
This changelog is not an exhaustive list of changes, some minor improvements in other areas were also made, some bugs were fixed, and some localization inaccuracies corrected.

We have also added the widgets of the other games of the Strategic Mind series. While some of you may feel unhappy about it, please, bear in mind that it is the only 100% reliable way for us to let you know about the new title coming up.
We look forward to more feedback from you!
With best regards
Starni Games team
Added full Polish text localization.
As promised, we added Steam Leaderboards. Only the progress made after the 3.04 update will be counted.

After each operation, your victory points score is multiplied by the difficulty multiplier (ranging 6-50), allowing you to get up to 20 000 points per operation. All operation scores in one playthrough are added. So, by completing a full campaign on Challenging difficulty you will get 200 000 points out of 400 000 maximum (max custom difficulty).

As promised, we added Steam Community items: trading cards, badges, wallpapers, and emoticons. If you want to know more about it, stay tuned for the next issues of our Developers’ Diaries, where we will go into more detail.
Fixed camera centering on the selected unit by double click on it. Previously, it did not work in certain situations.
Fixed incorrect descriptions for US global flags with bonuses to Strategic aviation.
Doris Miller now requires dealing 20 damage versus aircraft instead of 30. Note that it counts only lethal damage.
Added a second trigger to Iwo-Jima’s secondary objective about enemy hideouts. Now, you cannot miss that objective.
We will keep working on adding new features and fixing any issues you report.
With best regards
Starni Games team

items.text: You asked us to add Steam achievements since the game release. It did take us quite a while, but finally, the achievements are live. We hope that you will enjoy the additional reward for the sophisticated and large-scale operations of Strategic Mind: The Pacific.
Finally, your saves files will be stored in the Steam cloud. So, you no longer risk losing them and can easily transfer them to another device.
Now, you can change the language in Steam settings before you launch the game.
Also, now your Steam language is set as the game language by default.
Now there is a new set of controls ("Modern") set by default. The old controls are now "Legacy" controls. You can change between the two in the Settings->Game->Controls section.
Unit selection - Left mouse button
Attack/Movement - Right mouse button
Open unit info - Middle (wheel) mouse button (or "I" hotkey)
Unit selection - Left mouse button
Attack/Movement - Left mouse button
Open unit info - Right mouse button

items.text: Added 5-part tutorial in ground combat, supplied, infrastructure, etc.

You can see the day/night cycle and the current date (icon in the top right corner)
Improved the Manual UI
Sniper squad
Molotov cocktail
Smoke grenade
Spaced armor
Searchlights (small, medium, big)
Now incendiary bomb/shells and armor-piercing bombs/shells cost 0 Prestige to install on your unit, but instead each time you use them you have to spend:
3 Prestige for an Incendiary shell
5 Prestige for an Armor-piercing shell
5 Prestige for an Incendiary bomb
5 Prestige for an Armor-piercing bomb
Recon units can now use mortars and recoilless guns
Slight changes in various equipment stats and cost
Reworked AI (it is less "suicidal" now).
If the unit has already attacked this turn it cannot change Equipment until the end of turn.

Reinforcement no longer costs Command points (only Prestige). Prestige cost is now x2 of what you would have had to spend at the end of the operation. (On default settings 40% of unit cost (it was 50% before)).
Removed experience cap (per turn) for all units
Increased the experience required to gain a 2-5th level

The maximum level for heroes is lowered from 10 to 5 (If you already had high-level heroes they will remain as before with all the skills, but will not be able to level up further. Also, their stats bonus is capped at +5.)
Now killing an enemy unit with a hero gives +50 Exp instead of +10.
You can now set the Unit speech volume separately from other sources
Fixed disable/enable hex grid option
H; Show/hide hex grid
I; Show Unit info screen of the selected unit
Alt; Show unit outlines (if disabled)
F1; Show hotkeys list
Additionally, we fixed a number of bugs and added some other minor improvements along the way.
We will keep updating and supporting Strategic Mind: The Pacific as well as other titles of the Strategic Mind series. We are working on Polish localization and plan to add it soon.
We hope that we will enjoy playing the revamped version of the game. If there are still some issues left unfixed - make sure to let us know on the community hub.
With best regards
Starni Games development team

items.text: The second Strategic Mind series installment is upon us, so we would like to treat you all with one of our cinematics:

In this video, we present part of the in-game cinematic after the victory in the Battle of Moscow. Do not worry that this might be the ending spoiler - as this happens after the 15th operation out of 20. So, you have 5 more battles and 25-30% of all content still ahead of you. Our campaign has 20 operations, 16 historical, and 4 alternate history (including Sea Lion and Herkules). However, in some of the 16 historical ones you can get a better outcome.

Our whole team at Starni Games and all the people involved in the Strategic Mind: Blitzkrieg development have worked very hard to deliver you the best game we can. Now the time has come for you to evaluate our work. Let us know what is well-done and what needs to be further improved. Your feedback has always been the main source of our inspiration and our performance benchmark. We want to further develop and improve the game - so, please, join us at the community hub and let us discuss what we all have and what we all want.
As for Strategic Mind: The Pacific - we will bring it up to date with the majority of new features within a reasonable time, so stay tuned for further announcements.
If you are curious to play the Strategic Mind: Blitzkrieg - we welcome you!
With best regards
Starni Games development team

items.text: In today’s update 2.06 we fix more issues reported by the community and improved German localization.

Corrected all German “technical localization” (all the abilities, ship parts descriptions, etc.) There might still be some things to fix with the new version, which we will address in later updates, but over we expect the quality of localization to increase dramatically. Next, we will work on fixing German subtitles for cinematics. If you play the game with German localization on, please do let us know what you think about these fixes.

We made some changes to the Australia deployment phase: now you have only 4 deploy hexes in each location, representing the fact that not the whole fleet was able to reach Australia in time. You can deploy the rest of your units in the second deploy phase before turn 2. Additionally, we moved some of the enemy forces further away to balance out the increase in the difficulty of the objective to cover the Army landing.
Adjusted the stats of Japanese Ground transports, as some of them were incorrect. Additionally, the USA Ground transport LVT-4 now adds 2 Soft attack and 1 Hard attack as it had guns mounted on it.

Fixed an occasional tutorial issue when the player could not press the “Acquire” button (Reported by ChiefCommander33, and others). (It was quite hard to replicate, as it was not happening on any of the PCs in our office. Luckily, one of our friends has encountered it on her laptop and allowed us to borrow it for a few days. Even then it was hard to figure it out).

Fixed important crash (reported by Zephyr), which was happening after an Infantry unit spent all its movement points, then got new Ground transport, and it could still move on the transport causing a crash. Another variant of the same issue was crash after the Infantry with transport got overrun and was shown ineligible hexes to move to, and if the player chose to move there the game would crash.
Fix an issue with Japanese campaign 05 operation (reported by Nix), where completing objectives in a certain order would cause a crash.
Fix an issue with Japanese campaign 05 operation, the objective to pursue the enemy fleet was working incorrectly.
Fixed USA campaign 04 operation secondary objective to kill submarines not giving experience to your Destroyers as a part of the reward. (Reported by Tim)
Fixed USA campaign 06 operation secondary objective to capture the place where Marines barracks were not giving experience to your Marines as a part of the reward. (Reported by The Matrix has you!)
Fixed Japan campaign 05 operation secondary objective to prevent Zero capture, the turn timer was going up instead of going down.
Fixed a rare bug in Japanese campaign 08 operation, where you would fail secondary objective even if you captured oil storages. (Reported by aramoor50, thank you for the save files)
Fixed some visual elements on the map (eg. railroad on bridges etc) on several maps.
Fixed incorrect text in Japanese campaign 06 operations the secondary objective “capture the airfield at Munda” -> “Hold the airfield at Munda”. (Reported by Night_Phoenix)
Fixed dialogue when first attacking Tekketsu Kinotai in USA campaign operation 09.

In the Japanese campaign 06 operation we moved the completion of the main objective to hold all victory hexes one turn earlier so that you do not get a warning that you have the last turn before indecision penalty kicks in even though you did everything perfectly.

We would like to thank all of our community members who keep reporting all the occurring issues and help us to make the game better. We do appreciate your help. Additionally, we would like to thank Night Phoenix for his Lets play series covering the Japanese campaign, as it also helped us to identify and fix a couple of issues.
We will keep improving and polishing the game. Our team wishes everyone good holidays. Stay tuned as there are some big announcements coming.
With best regards
Starni Games development team

Added the Great Barrier Reef on 3 maps (no spoilers).

Fixed problem with some enemy units in tutorial being difficult to click on (you can now click on both the hex and the unit to attack it, whereas before you had to target unit only. This should make it easier to navigate through the tutorial)

Update 2.01
In today’s update 2.01 we addressed the most urgent issues which have arisen after the launch (version 2.00).
Added animation of torpedo attack for torpedo bombers attacking with torpedos. (So, you can now easily differentiate visually between a bomb and a torpedo aerial attacks)
Fixed problem with Carriers' count in the 4th operation of the Japanese campaign. (You have to restart the 4th operation for new changes to apply)

We would like to express our gratitude to all the community members, who reported most of these issues and thus helped us fix them as soon as possible and make the game better.
With best regards,
Starni Games development team

Fixed a few other problems causing crashes.
All these fixes were done with the help of crash report form. Once again we thank everyone who reports problems and thus helps us make a better game.

Fixed bug: when your aircraft landed at an Airfield with enemy controlled supply point / maritime hub and then you capture the supply point / maritime hub then your Aircraft gets Ammunition and Fuel but does not restore Damaged strength. Now it does restore.
Fixed visual problem: when an Aircraft lands on a Carrier the hex where it was before the landing is still highlighted after the landing as if it is there.
That`s it for today`s update.
We move step-by-step towards a higher quality of the game. Today`s update is another step in that direction.
Our team wishes you all a good weekend!
Update 1.02
Fixed several issues causing crashes. (With the help of our new crash report form)

Since 1.01 update many players have used crash report form to send us information about these issues. These reports allowed us to fix some of them in a timely manner. We thank everyone who used the form to report problems. It is a tremendous help.
We believe that when your help is added to our continuous efforts, the resulting synergy will increase the quality of the final product by a considerable margin.

Note that you can enter your comment in the crash report form, and it will be more helpful if you could describe what you were doing when the crash occurred. (Sometimes it is unclear, so you may leave that field empty if there was no particular action before the crash)
We hope that now there are less crashes and your playing experience will be more enjoyable. However, should you encounter any crashes you now know what to do.
Make sure to report any crashes you encounter to add your personal contribution towards a final version of the game.
Starni games development team
Update 1.01

Added automatic crash report form allowing you to send us data on the crash. (While send us a save file is still the best way to help us fix an issue, this form is an invaluable tool to deal with so-called “random” or irregular crashes which happen unpredictably and are difficult to track down.)

Fixed issues with fatal errors which happen every time from a certain save file. (Some irregular crushes might still happen, but the reported issues (with enclosed save files) which could be replicated are now fixed.) The saves you sent us should now work without crashes.

We thank all of our players who posted these issues on our community hub and sent us save files, so we could locate the problem and solve it in a timely manner. Your help is what allowed us to quickly locate and fix the problem. Make sure to let us know if there are still some problems. We are certain that together we can make a great game!
First feedback
We scrutinized the feedback of the first few days to learn what troubles you the most and you would like us to change or add into the game.

As stated above, your crash reports were a tremendous help in fixing crashes you have reported. We are sure that with your help we can gradually polish Strategic Mind: The Pacific to a near perfect state.

We also took notice of your proposals and requests, number one being to allow further camera position (to give you a better overview of the battlefield). We could not add it in today`s update, but we are working on it. Some things you propose are already being worked on, whilst others we add to our “to do” list.
Also, there are first few playthroughs of the first operation “The Battle of the Coral Sea” recorded by the players. You can easily find them on YouTube.

We are happy that you guys took time to create these videos even though our game is quite challenging and requires some getting used to its mechanics. We look forward to watching you play the next two operations.

Lastly, one of the most active community members - Stonedog has started to put together all the useful information about the game. (https://steamcommunity.com/app/991810/discussions/0/1649917420740367068/) We hope it will help everyone to get a better grasp of the game. We plan to add a proper tutorial and manual on full release, but until then we are happy that there are experienced and willing-to-help community members out there to help everyone else get a better understanding of the game.
We hope that with the help of volunteering community members our development team can achieve much better results. We thank you all for your contribution towards making a better game.
Starni Games development team
